tools.name: value_business
tools.description: Estimates a valuation range, 0-100 investor score, archetype, and top three improvement priorities for a business from its operating metrics: revenue model, MRR, monthly churn, month-over-month growth, and months live, plus optional active users, CAC, and LTV. For a business the user owns or operate

tools.name: analyze_listing
tools.description: Evaluates a business-for-sale listing (Acquire.com, Flippa, broker) against EvalyMe's model: valuation range, whether the asking price is below, within, or above it, and the asking price as a multiple of ARR and of profit. Accepts the figures a listing states; any figure not supplied gets a document

tools.name: explain_methodology
tools.description: Returns EvalyMe's published valuation methodology: the formula, base multiples by revenue model, factor adjustments and caps, investor-score weights, archetype rules, limitations, and versioning policy. For explaining or citing how an EvalyMe valuation was produced.
